entities.summary:
Spiśské Vlachy is a town in eastern Slovakia. It is in the Spiš region. It is now administratively in the district of Spišská Nová Ves, which is part of the Košice Region. The adjective "Spišské" is used to distinguish it from 6 other towns listed as "Olasz" or "Olaszi" in an 1828 Hungarian property tax list. Two “Town wards” (suburbs) belong to Spišské Vlachy:Dobra Voľa lies to the north and
Zahura lies to the south.
